name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Grzegorz Braun
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Grzegorz Braun, a Polish member of the European Parliament. Polish prosecutors asked for this because they want to charge him over several alleged offences in 2025: taking a Ukrainian flag from a town hall balcony, taking a European Union flag from a ministry lobby, destroying an exhibition about LGBTQ+ people in the Polish parliament building, and making remarks that could discredit the Museum of the History of Polish Jews. Lifting immunity lets the Polish case go ahead.

- Polish prosecutors can now pursue criminal proceedings against Grzegorz Braun over the alleged offences.
- It affects Grzegorz Braun, a member of the European Parliament elected in Poland.
- The Parliament's President sends the decision to the Polish authorities and to Braun.
